Name: Real Life Horses
Author: Minakie
TagLine: Horse retexture and recolors based on real life horses.
Description:
__**THESE IMAGES ARE SUPPOSED TO BE MOVING!**__
__If you do not see them moving on your computer, it means your browser doesn't support animated .png's yet.__
__You can fix it by installing [APNG](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/apng/ehkepjiconegkhpodgoaeamnpckdbblp) .__

![](http://stardewvalley.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/horse.gif)     ![](https://s20.postimg.cc/fq5vlnakt/running_sideways_animation.png)

![](https://s20.postimg.cc/guvcda7nx/running_down_animation.png)![](https://s20.postimg.cc/fxox4ew5p/running_up_animation.png)![](https://s20.postimg.cc/jxw2gnmml/eating_animation.png)
<s>![](https://i.postimg.cc/zXgDX0nc/about-the-mod.png) </s>

This horse retexture was inspired by both avalitor's [Redesigned Horse Running Animation](http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/261/) and Kitana Coldfire's [Bigger Draft Horse Model](http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/bigger-draft-horse-model-clydesdale-skin.112941/). All the horse colors were inspired by real horses.

![](https://s20.postimg.cc/lj6quq7gt/America_Cream_Draft_horse_apng.png)American Cream Draft horse
![](https://s20.postimg.cc/akvhcjivh/Andalusian_horse_apng.png)Andalusian horse
![](https://s20.postimg.cc/fm7grnfpp/Buckskin_horse_apng.png)Buckskin horse ![](https://s20.postimg.cc/qx5j29x71/Buckskin_horse_(Spirit)_apng.png)Buckskin horse ([Spirit: Stallion Of The Cimarron](http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0166813/?ref_=plg_rt_1))
![](https://s20.postimg.cc/h52uwmma5/Icelandic_horse_apng.png)Icelandic horse
![](https://s20.postimg.cc/5p11cbxhp/Shire_horse_(black)_apng.png)Shire horse (black) Shire horse ![](https://s20.postimg.cc/ysp98kll9/Shire_horse_(brown_with_grey_muzzle)_apng.png)(brown with grey muzzle) ![](https://s20.postimg.cc/64cb5cjf1/Shire_horse_(brown_with_pink_muzzle)_apng.png)Shire horse (brown with pink muzzle)**![](https://i.postimg.cc/sgCjB7mD/note.png)**

If you feel like the horses look a bit weird with the game's reins (I know I do), you can download the [Removed Reins](http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/tractor-v-1-3-horse-replacement.108604/#post-2811868) mod by Zhuria. ;)

**__**![](https://i.postimg.cc/XJq4M8jx/related-mods.png)

- Want more horse breeds using my base? Check out [Better Horses](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1421/?)  and [Epona](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2154) .
- Having difficulty choosing between having a horse, a mule, a unicorn, a pegasus, a dragon, a wolf, a broom or a vehicle? With [Adopt N' Skin](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011)  you can have them all! Simply adopt a bunch of wild horses and apply a different visual look to each one. :)
